data.source_title: Shift-to-shift handoffs in the NICU: lessons learned from a large scale audit
data.locator: Abstract, Study design and Results; family presence and participation among observed shift-to-shift handoffs.
data.source_setting: NICU provider and nursing shift handoffs at 40 centers in a learning collaborative.
data.source_period: 10-month audit period; exact calendar dates not stated. Published online 14 July 2023.
data.quantity: Family presence at handoff and active family participation conditional on presence
data.unit: percent; participation denominator is handoffs where family was present
data.source_evidence_basis: The multi-center observational audit reports family presence at 5.9% of handoffs; among handoffs where a family member was present, 48.2% included contribution of information, questions, or shared goals.
data.limitations: Audit measure from participating learning-collaborative centers, not a representative census of NICUs. Full article is subscription content; only primary publisher abstract was accessible in this review. These are handoff behavior observations, not family preference or quality-outcome estimates.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Represent shift handoff as a distinct transition and allow family presence/participation as an optional actor with locally defined access, consent, and timing; do not make the observed percentages target rates.
